vectors.name: tl-01-inclusion-proof-verifies
vectors.description: Append 5 entries, generate inclusion proof for leaf 2, verify against computed root. Expected: verify_inclusion returns Ok.

vectors.name: tl-02-tampered-inclusion-proof-rejected
vectors.description: Flip one bit in the audit path; verify_inclusion must reject. Expected: Merkle(InclusionProofInvalid).

vectors.name: tl-03-consistency-proof-verifies
vectors.description: Build 4-entry store, snapshot old_root, append 2 more (6 total), generate consistency proof (4->6), verify against both roots. Expected: verify_consistency returns Ok. Power-of-two old_size edge case.

vectors.name: tl-04-tampered-consistency-proof-rejected
vectors.description: Flip one bit in the consistency proof; verify_consistency must reject. Expected: Merkle(ConsistencyProofInvalid).

vectors.name: tl-05-sth-signs-and-verifies
vectors.description: Sign an STH with the log-signing key pair (seed [13]/[14]), verify the STH with matching pub keys. Expected: verify_sth returns Ok.

vectors.name: tl-06-forged-sth-rejected
vectors.description: SECURITY-CRITICAL negative: AND-enforce / no-downgrade assertion. Sign a valid STH, then remove the ML-DSA-65 signature entry. verify_sth must return Err(SignatureInvalid). Confirms that Ed25519-only acceptance is not possible (no downgrade).

vectors.name: tl-07-sth-rewind-rejected
vectors.description: Sign two STHs; new has tree_size < old AND timestamp < old. verify_sth_sequence (now verifies both STH signatures first) must return Err(SthError::Rewind).

vectors.name: tl-08-revoked-key-detect-advisory
vectors.description: Append an image-key-revocation entry for the image-signing key (seed [1]/[2]), generate inclusion proof, verify it is in the log. Advisory: cutoff enforcement is client-side in Phase-0 (detection-only, no block per ADR_012 contract).

vectors.name: tl-09-disable-list-entry-via-log
vectors.description: Build a genesis-disable-list entry, append to store, generate inclusion proof, call verify_entry_included_and_authentic with GENESIS_DISABLE_LIST_PAYLOAD_TYPE. Both inclusion and attestation must verify. Expected: Ok.

vectors.name: tl-10-lkg-tuple-appended-and-retrievable
vectors.description: Build an LKG tuple entry (entries::build_lkg_tuple), append it, verify the stored leaf hash matches the independently computed leaf_hash(ts, jcs). Expected: hash match.

vectors.name: tl-11-entry-included-but-wrongly-signed-rejected
vectors.description: Inclusion != authenticity negative (P0-2 repro). Build an entry with valid OID content but attestation signed under WRONG payloadType (cross-type forgery). Append to store; verify_inclusion alone passes (leaf is genuinely in the tree). verify_entry_included_and_authentic must reject: Err(AttestationInvalid). Confirms that inclusion alone is not sufficient.

vectors.name: tl-12-split-view-not-detected-single-client-honest-limit
vectors.description: Demonstrate the honest limit: a single client with a single honest log connection cannot detect split-view attacks in Phase-0. Gossip/multi-party STH comparison is PAPER (Phase-1+). Expected: test documents the gap, does not fabricate a detection claim.

vectors.name: tl-13-wrong-length-inclusion-proof-rejected
vectors.description: Append one element to the audit path; verify_inclusion must reject the malformed proof before any hash computation. Expected: Merkle(InclusionProofMalformed).

vectors.name: tl-14-wrong-length-consistency-proof-rejected
vectors.description: Append one element to the consistency proof; verify_consistency must reject the malformed proof before any hash computation. Expected: Merkle(ConsistencyProofMalformed).

vectors.name: tl-15-root-hash-not-an-oid
vectors.description: Verify that mth() and oid_of() produce different digests for the same entry JSON, confirming the two hash domains are structurally distinct (no aliasing risk between the log root and the CDRO OID namespace).

vectors.name: tl-16-log-unreachable-alert-fires
vectors.description: LogUnreachableState with recheck_interval_ms=1000; calling check_freshness at last_sth_time_ms + 2001 must return true (alert). At last_sth_time_ms + 500 must return false (within interval).

vectors.name: tl-17-merkle-leaf-encoding-determinism
vectors.description: RFC 6962 compliance / cross-implementation interop guard (P0-1 repro). Independently compute the 2-leaf tree root as sha256(0x01 || sha256(0x00||MerkleTreeLeaf0) || sha256(0x00||MerkleTreeLeaf1)) and assert it equals store.compute_root(). Before fix: double-hash in mth() meant actual != expected. After fix: single 0x00 domain application, actual == expected.

vectors.name: tl-ex-01-empty-tree-hash-is-sha256-empty
vectors.description: mth([]) must equal SHA-256(b"") per RFC 6962. Expected: hex matches known SHA-256 empty vector e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855.

vectors.name: tl-ex-02-duplicate-oid-rejected
vectors.description: Append an entry, then attempt to append another entry with the same oid. Expected: TranslogError::DuplicateOid on the second append.

vectors.name: tl-ex-03-sth-sequence-monotone-ok
vectors.description: Sign two STHs with strictly increasing tree_size and timestamp. verify_sth_sequence(old, new, pub_keys) must return Ok. Verifies both STH signatures before the monotone check.

vectors.name: tl-ex-04-build-attestation-appended-and-verified
vectors.description: Build a build-attestation entry (entries::build_build_attestation), append it to a store, generate inclusion proof, verify via store.verify_inclusion. Expected: Ok.
